notes.title: TPP工作室新作，开放世界江湖模拟器《龙胤立志传》首次测试现已开启
notes.content:
嘿，各位老朋友们！好久不见啦~
感谢大家一直以来的支持，是你们让《归家异途》的世界变得完整，也让我们有动力继续做更多好玩的游戏！

憋了这么久，终于可以大声宣布：​我们的新作[b]《龙胤立志传》[/b]首次测试正式开启啦！​
现在前往Steam商店页面，点击"申请测试权限"按钮即可免费入库体验。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202030

我们怀着对武侠的一腔热忱，希望能够做出一款自由的开放世界江湖模拟器。这里的一草一木、一招一式都倾注了我们对武侠的热爱。如今剑胚初成，虽未至吹毛断发之境，却已蕴三分侠气。
虽然还不够完美，但正因如此才需要测试来听取各位大侠的真知灼见。期待与你在这片江湖相遇，共同见证它的成长。

--------------------
《龙胤立志传》是一款融合门派经营的开放世界武侠游戏。在各大门派割据一方的神州之上，你可以自由驰骋，历经奇遇，修炼神功，踏上行侠仗义或行凶作恶之路。也可以经营自己的门派，从无名小派成长为武林霸主，攻城略地，称霸一方，最终谱写一段独一无二的武林传奇。

[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1iaZhYvE72/]点击查看PV[/url]
--------------------
[b][h2]游戏亮点[/h2][/b]
[h3]探索真实江湖[/h3]
从繁华市井到塞外荒原，你可以自由探索神州每一寸土地。游历动态的武侠世界，体验即时发生的无数事件，结识各方能人异士，体悟江湖快意恩仇。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/d60471671d7f875fab62271f3797ebb238dd32e5.gif[/img]

江湖儿女之间从来不会缺少爱恨情仇。世界中近千名NPC皆拥有独特的性格、倾向和喜好。你可以投其所好成为莫逆之交，或是暗箭伤人结下深仇大恨。若交情匪浅，他们还会飞鸽传书与你邀约相聚，请求救援，或相约共闯龙潭虎穴，一同夺取惊人宝藏！你也可以选择心仪之对象，海誓山盟，喜结连理。但若三心二意，始乱终弃，恐怕也难逃严峻之惩罚。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/fce7cf6dc75118309d8a87ceeaa129ebcef22112.gif[/img]

[h3]修炼绝世神功[/h3]
从武当少林的名门正宗，到唐门五毒的剑走偏锋，乃至墨家神机门的机关异兽，近千种武学自由搭配，打通经脉功法，将你的角色培养成独树一帜的武林高手。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/355778d3aabfca72dc52d70a2f658948afa68dbc.gif[/img]

[h3]打造最强门派[/h3]
从外门弟子一步步积累门派功绩，直至成为掌门！管理门派建筑营造，科研外交；将天下神功尽数收入藏经阁，供弟子修习参阅；设置每名弟子的工作重心，因材施教，并率领他们惩奸除恶或横行霸道；最终将自己的门派建设成江湖中一支举足轻重之力量。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/39554617242e65fb7d5b64668c2f371b3bfe1d23.gif[/img]

[h3]书写乱世传奇[/h3]
乱世是专属于侠客的舞台，你可以招贤纳士，合纵连横，率领弟子与其他门派一较高下，攻占并且吞并敌方的城池。或许终有一日能够一统神州，成就万世之功业！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/ccb0ac148477f8d55e86f920b431f2ae8db8886e.gif[/img]

--------------------
[h3]游玩反馈问卷[/h3]
《龙胤立志传》还在成长阶段，每一个真实的反馈对我们都非常珍贵。
无论你是喜欢现在的玩法，还是遇到了任何不爽的体验，都请告诉我们——你的每一条建议，都可能让这个江湖世界变得更好。

[h3][b]我们将在5月6日，在完成问卷的侠士中，随机抽取3位，赠送steam礼品卡。[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Version Update 1.0.3f0
notes.content:
Hey revolutionaries! The November update is here as promised.
We are excited to announce that we have completed all work listed on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1220010/announcements/detail/3106916883155694882]previously published roadmap[/url]. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for Home Behind 2!

The v1.0.3f0 update includes:

[b]- 1 new side mission: Challenge Psychic Agent, a new boss class, to earn special armor rewards.[/b]
[quote]How to unlock this quest:
[olist][*]Complete Secret Base, the first main mission.
[*]Arrive at an area with a Danger of 4 or higher.
[*]Explore 15 or more areas (chance to spawn side mission increases with each area explored; explore 25 areas for a 100% chance).[/olist]
Mission path:
[olist][*]After triggering the mission, a nearby area with a Danger of 5 or higher will be chosen as the mission target.
[*]Explore the area and enter the Library to fight members of a Research Squad. Face off against the Psychic Agent, a new boss, in the last room.
[*]Defeat the Psychic Agent and complete the mission to receive a special piece of armor with the "Psychic Agent" modifier. Clear the mission on Hard mode or a higher difficulty to unlock the secret playable class "Psychic Agent" (female only).[/olist]
Complete the mission to trigger a special event — Brain Implant.[/quote]
[i]Psychic Agent[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/28c2aff1bc870c091257329c0e02f110de470e61.png[/img]
[b]Skills[/b]
[quote]Soul Steal
Deal damage to an enemy and inflict Stun, Jam, or Silence. Steal a portion of the target's HP and Morale. Skill effect increases for each point of difference in Intelligence.
Terrorize
Deal damage to an enemy and inflict Stun, Jam, or Silence. Steal a portion of the target's Morale.
Brain Bite
Steal a portion of a target's Intelligence and Resolve over time. Skill effect increases for each point of difference in Intelligence.[/quote]

[b]- 5 new rare recipes: Mending Stew, Radiant Cocktail, Fermented Juice, Queen's Decaburger, Fungi Soup. Each offers relatively strong positive and negative effects.[/b]
[quote]Mending Stew: Strength +10, Resist Injury -15%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/d9415dda8a98de13e86da637d392c4b854e653f7.png[/img]
Radiant Cocktail: Agility +10, Loot -15%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/43ad5b168bac1b07884af7998db822fce9e0f76a.png[/img]
Fermented Juice: Intelligence +10, Morale -15%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/ff2d74392bac29f5d3efd688ab6919a4c95c61ba.png[/img]
Queen's Decaburger: Fitness +10, Supplies Cost +30%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/f97657e93e34fd60fa1b706c211b8263d26d6cd5.png[/img]
Fungi Soup: Resolve +10, EXP -30%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/f1cd49e5e88ed1370a69203580245ec025d0e678.png[/img][/quote]
[b]- New mail: World powers which have a good relationship with the Revolutionaries will offer obsolete gear for sale at a large discount.[/b]
[quote]A stronger relationship with a world power increases the chance they will make an offer. Offers include 1 to 3 weapons, armor, trinkets, or medicine at a 20% to 40% discount.[/quote]
[b]- 1 new enemy squad - Research Squad[/b]
[quote]Research Squads can include Bio Soldiers, Surgeons, Daisy Mercs, Pharmacists, Chemists, Engineers, Radiation Engineers, and Signal Officers.[/quote]
[b]- Optimized auto fight logic, including an independent toggle for fighters' 3 skills and their auto use settings.[/b]
[quote]Check the Auto Settings menu in the upper right of fighters' avatars to enable and disable auto use of skills.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/80ab2251ae43a1b860a57f7dcdf6dd4cd3b70f58.png[/img]
[b]- Adjusted and enhanced effects of the Chemist's skills.[/b]
[quote]Increased Chemical Spray damage.
Increased healing effect and duration of Rapid Healing.
Removed Silence from possible random effects caused by Rage Injection.[/quote]
[b]- Adjusted and improved effects on special gear earned as rewards from all missions.[/b]

[b]- Fine-tuned reward values of some events.[/b]

We wish you continued success on your journeys through Home Behind 2!

Producer
ZPP

notes.title: Version Update 1.0.2f0
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

The August update is now available. We are also excited to announce our participation in Steam Survival Fest 2022!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/467960

Home Behind 2 will be on sale at a 30% discount during this Steam event. If you already own the game, this is a great chance to gift it to your friends!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18800/_/

The v1.0.2f0 update includes:

— [b]3 new jobs and fresh enemy squads that include them[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Radiation Engineer[/b]
The radioactive weaponry utilized by this engineer is terrifying, not only permanently weakening enemies in battle but also reducing their ability to recover.

[b]Skills[/b]
Nuclear Grenade
Deal damage to all enemies, decrease all of their stats, and slightly decrease their Heal Effect.

Depleted Uranium Bomb
Deal damage to an enemy and decrease all of their stats.

Irradiated Smoke
Deal damage to all enemies and greatly decrease their Heal Effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/435318c4332d304ab6a58f215731022731761343.png[/img]
[*][b]Signal Officer[/b]
Signal Officers provide their allies with reliable intel while interfering with enemy communications to send them spiraling into chaos.

[b]Skills[/b]
Important Intel
Target the ally with the highest damage, then increase their Accuracy and Crit Rate.

Signal Flare
Target the enemy with the highest damage, inflict Jam or Silence, and then Mark them.

Radio Interference
Inflict Jam, Silence, or Stun on all Marked enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/207b0c8e311d6804a60ae80e0750e30dc603d309.png[/img]
[*][b]Cook[/b]
Although many military chefs lack true culinary skills, their mess call can be more satisfying to hear than the horn of victory.

[b]Skills[/b]
Scrumptious Meal
Heal all allies, then increase all of their stats and Heal Effect.

Biscuits
Heal the ally with the lowest HP, then increase all of their stats and Heal Effect.

Energy Drink
Target the ally with the highest Morale, then increase all of their stats and Morale.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/99d5d461f955b545a8b433b98548c7019ad9baa5.png[/img]
[/list] 

— [b]3 new area features[/b]	
[list]
[*]Trade Center: Trade resources freely at low cost. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/5c468d15dfa3e6a16754508ff81b2149e996b5a3.png[/img]
[*]Clearance: Most items in this area are sold at a discount. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/2c027754bb28cc13efb75ea858391dd3754dd41a.png[/img]
[*]Hyperinflation: Prices of most items in this area have soared.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/3b986459b2fbf3c4915519106b32f570869cfecb.png[/img]
[/list] 

— [b]2 new news events[/b]: Car Bomb and Army Corruption
 [quote][b]Car Bomb[/b]
In recent days, a spree of car bombs have detonated across cities controlled by the Scarian Army, apparently targeting railway stations, police stations, markets, and government buildings. Many civilians and soldiers have been killed. While the government's spokespeople claim that the Revolutionaries are to blame, the Revolutionaries counter that the attacks are false flags planned by Akadullah to strike fear in Scarian hearts.

[b]Army Corruption[/b] (Day 45 or later)
Recent reports state that "Akadullah is furious" over rampant corruption in the highest levels of his Army. Some of his soldiers have been actively avoiding combat and retreating from confrontations with Revolutionaries. There are even whispers of a "whitelist" - a list of anti-government combatants who are to receive special treatment from the Army, such as being spared from heavy firepower and elite squadrons.
 [/quote]

— [b]2 new camp events[/b]: Scrapped Vehicle and Comrade's Request
 [quote][b]Scrapped Vehicle[/b]
XX was fortunate enough to stumble upon a scrapped vehicle from an unknown local fighting force. We may be able to salvage some valuable parts from its shell.

[b]Comrade's Request[/b]
XX wishes to temporarily leave the team to handle some personal affairs with an "old acquaintance" in the area. While they are reluctant to discuss their true intentions, whether they are sending a gift or a barrage of bullets is none of your concern. [/quote]

We appreciate your continued love and support for Home Behind 2! As always, we will continue to follow our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1220010/announcements/detail/3106916883155694882]published development roadmap[/url], and are on track to release another update this coming November.

Producer
ZPP

Buy rare weapon
Buy rare armor
Buy rare trinkets
Buy rare medicine
Buy rare Blueprint
Buy rare vehicle weaponry
Buy rare recipe[/quote]
- [b]Added missionaries NPC and their generation logic[/b]
[quote][b]Missionaries[/b]
This sect has their own militia who ensure the safety and stability of their faith and home. They have long declared their neutrality, and continue to act in good faith with both the government and the Revolutionaries.
[b]Donate[/b]
Spend a moderate amount of money to gain the favor of the Order.
[b]Say a prayer[/b]
Spending a small amount of money is equivalent to "Make a sacrifice" to a random god.
Buy medicine
Buy trinket[/quote]

The people in this tribe still maintain their ancient traditions and way of life: tending herds, fishing, hunting, and going to war. Their ancestral homeland is shrinking, more and more of their land being taken during the war. They are no friends of the government - or the Revolutionaries.
[b]Donate[/b]
Spend a moderate amount of money to gain the favor of the Tribe.

Performing a divination increases or decreases team morale according to the divination results.
Buy supplies
Buy weapon[/quote]

[quote]Added corpses and treasure chests for random events like Battle Wreckage and defensive positions that can be clicked to obtain resources.[/quote]
- [b]Added new mechanic for vehicle weapons - Slow[/b]: Greatly reduce speed of enemy vehicles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/b8620635211db82be7e89a7a6c0a5a2c4309b869.png[/img]

[quote]Codenamed Gamma, one of Akadullah's elite personal guards, graduated third of her class at the Woman's Military Academy in Scaria. Her real name and family history are unknown.

According to intelligence, her incredible survivability and oppressive combat techniques make her the perfect hunter to track down Revolutionaries.[/quote]
-Added [b]Autoplay[/b] function to the plot dialogue

- Forging failure will now refund [b]25% of material consumption[/b]

notes.title: Home Behind 2 1.0 - Out Now
notes.content:
Dear Revolutionaries:

Time flies, and it has been a year since Home Behind 2 launched on Steam in early access on January 22, 2021.

The Home Behind 2 v1.0 update is finally live today! We’d like to say thanks to our loyal players who accompanied us through the Early Access phase. Your feedback and support have been invaluable to us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/7ec7f6ab6d798fc3fab2eca7be116cb726bc6e1d.jpg[/img]
In the past journey, the game has undergone a total of 25+ updates. During this period, we added:
[list]
    [*]2 new modes
    [*]Hell difficulty
    [*]15+ classes and NPCs 
    [*]14+ random tactics and skill mechanics
    [*]22+ quests and events
    [*]Multiple regional features
[/list]

Over the past year, we have added new content, optimized in-game functions, and have further balanced the game’s core mechanics.

Thanks again to our longtime players who have provided us feedback and support during the Early Access. Home Behind 2 is a better game because all of you! We also welcome new players to the game and hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it!

V1.0 is the end of Early Access, but it is not the end of Home Behind 2. We have announced the 2022 development roadmap, and we will work hard to optimize and improve the game based on your feedback.

[previewyoutube=gpLW-pIVNiw;full][/previewyoutube]
The detailed update content of v1.0 is as follows:

[h1]v1.0 Update[/h1]
[h3][b]Hidden Story[/b][/h3]
Added a hidden story after finishing the game under Hard difficulty. The story is related to Home Behind and makes the story of Home Behind more complete.

[h3][b]Boss and related side quests[/b][/h3]
Added a new Boss "Vulture" and related side tasks and stories. During the exploration process, players will randomly encounter the revolutionary army that was attacked by the Vulture   and will finally face this formidable enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/94f28836ca5fb1328ab5a776091245feb7534ac8.png[/img]
Skills:
[quote][b]Peck[/b]
Deals damage to one enemy unit (fitness gap increases skill effectiveness), reduces enemy's fitness and accuracy and applies a jam effect

[b]Rot[/b]
Deals damage to one enemy unit, reduces their fitness, applies a seize effect

[b]Soar[/b]
Increases own fitness, speed, and dodge[/quote]

[h3][b]New job and skill mechanics[/b][/h3]
Added 3 new common jobs:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/6acab50399a9ac99b546682ca25034790d3f1e39.png[/img]
[b]Machine Gunner[/b]:
Machine Gunners seek nothing more than the perfect gun. Seeing their enemies fall to their firepower is their greatest source of joy.
Skill:
[quote][b]Overheated Shot[/b]
Reduces own defense, greatly increases damage and crit damage

[b]Rapid Shot[/b]
Increases own accuracy and crit rate

[b]Water Cooling[/b]
Increases own speed and comes with a jam effect[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/d3eb9a5aacf64ec28a764fa84a5051a3b2ce3d31.png[/img]
[b]Chemist[/b]: 
Most of their knowledge is rooted in ancestral recipes and explosive outcomes from random experiments. Their products can often be... unpredictable.
Skill:
[quote][b]Chemical Spray[/b]
Deals continuous damage to all enemies and adds a random effect: jam/silence/stun/immunity

[b]Rapid Healing[/b]

Continuously heals one allied unit and adds a random effect: immunity/invincible/mark/stun

[b]Rage Injection[/b]
Heals and increases the morale of one allied unit with a  random effect: invincible/undying/jam/silence[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/a153da7b228a37bc2c5b652e5816eaf8f15d7fb4.png[/img]
[b]Engineer[/b]: 
Instead of fighting their enemies head on, Engineers install a large number of hovering turrets and liquid nitrogen turrets to exhaust their targets.
Skill:
[quote][b]Superior Enhancement[/b]
Sacrifice own speed in exchange for Enhance Summon

[b]Hover Turret[/b]
Sacrifice your own speed to summon a hover turret, which is mainly used for damage dealing

[b]Nitrogen Turret[/b]
Sacrifice your own speed to summon a nitrogen turret, which can slow down the enemies and reduce their dodge[/quote]

Added 3 skill mechanics. These mechanics have been added to the old and new jobs. The balance of some jobs has been adjusted.

[quote][b]Jam[/b]: Unable to use basic attacks
[b]Random effect[/b]: The final effect of the skill is random
[b]Enhance Summon[/b]: Enhance all the stats of what you summoned[/quote]

[h3][b]Random tactics[/b][/h3]
Added 5 new random tactics:

[b]Witch's Brew[/b]
An occult potion derived from ancient Scarian legends said to have wonderful - but unpredictable - effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/3d06243637003399a0b06f0661b2f89371020713.png[/img]
[b]Thermal Imager[/b]
This high-tech device exposes the heat signatures of enemies behind or within a fortification.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/281cdac5eb0b15166e6811b160d23f5b791d4d02.png[/img]
[b]Nitrogen Tank[/b]

notes.title: Guidance of some common problems
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/5aa4e61b16b7b8026737851f8f801155a933b811.jpg[/img]
[b]1. Flash back, prompt crash, unable to enter the game[/b]
[list]
[*] Update or roll back the graphics card driver, install the directx repair tool and repair;
[*] Turn off all antivirus software in the computer;
[*] Set HomeBehind2.exe as an administrator, and allow HomeBehind2.exe to communicate in the Windows firewall
[*] If you still cannot enter the game after trying the above methods, please send us the error information file displayed in the crash information pop-up interface (the file format is generally Crash_a string of numbers)by email: support@coconutislandstudio.com
[/list]
[b]2. Save Data lost[/b]
It may be caused by not exiting the game normally and forcibly closing the game during the game save process. Please try not to use other methods such as alt+f4 to end the game process. 
If there is no response when the game exits, please wait for a period of time and the game should automatically close, do not close it forcefully.

[b]3. Game stuck[/b]
[list]
[*] Do not use Steam, directly check in the game from the folder
[*] Try to lower the resolution or play in window mode
[*] Turn off all antivirus software in the computer
[/list]
[b]4. Will the updated content take effect on the current archive?[/b]
Most updates can take effect on the current save, and there is no need to open a new game to play the game.
At present, only the modification of professional skill data will take effect after opening a new game (you can continue the game without opening a new file, but the existing characters in the player team will use the old version of the skill data).

notes.title: Current issues and problems
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/5fdfe7df25217835b293dcb0c03d44fe5cd57d59.jpg[/img]

Since Home Behind2 was released at 12 noon on January 22, we have received a lot of suggestions. First of all, thank you very much for your support of this game. Whether it is praise, suggestion or criticism, we have received it, and read it carefully. Since the development team has only two people and the human resource is not very abundant, our response speed may not be very fast. Here, I sincerely apologize to you. We promise you that we will try our best to fix bugs and improve your gaming experience as soon as possible.

The following are some of the problems that have been discovered so far:
1. Regarding the difficulty of the game: As this is a Roguelike game, there are some inherent settings, such as permanent death, and the randomness of encounters. At present, the two of us have begun to develop an update plan for the difficulty of the game, and we recommend novice players , In the early stage, priority should be given to avoiding high-risk areas marked on the map.

2. Automatic save: The game currently does not have an automatic save function. In order to improve your gaming experience, we have begun to add this function.

3. Legacy points reset: At present, we have noticed that some players will encounter the problem of resetting legacy points. We are working on this problem now.

4. Vehicle battle description: There are some areas to be improved in the settings of some vehicle battles, and we are working on a modification plan. In addition, for vehicles acquired by the player, such as trucks, the player will need to manually set the team member on the truck, and we will also set the reminder that the vehicle lacks personnel more clearly.
 
Thank you for your positive feedback. If you encounter some problems in the follow-up game, or want to feedback us improvement suggestions, please let us know by email: support@coconutislandstudio.com

Home Behind2 developed by TPP Studio has been launched on Steam by Early Access on January 22, 2021!ːsteamhappyː

[b]INTRODUCTION[/b]
Home Behind 2 is a Roguelike RPG which takes place in Scaria, a country engulfed in a civil war for 10 years. Lead a patchwork group of revolutionary fighters into the depths of the government's territory as you struggle to overthrow a brutal authoritarian regime!

[b]STORY[/b]
Home Behind2 will take players back to the Scaria, which is under the brutal rule of dictatorship. Some people resisted, some succumbed, some fell...
However, even if the road ahead is dark, there are still sporadic fire of hope in the war. 
The female college student Banan, the abandoned agent Prince and the chief's son Haroun will form a temporary guerrilla team and continue to advance in the dark.

[b]FEATURE[/b]
[list]
[*] Explore the randomly generated areas of western Scaria in this Roguelike RPG as you adventure, occupy enemy oil fields, and claim cities in the name of the Revolutionaries.
[*] A variety of unique terrains host hundreds of random events and buildings. Play to your team's strengths as you decide how to solve problems presented by your environment.
[*] Recruit and train dozens of guerilla fighters. Unlock 36 jobs, each with their own talents, stats, and battle skills, and assign your fighters to your team as you see fit.
[*] A strategic real-time combat system. Pause time to command your teammates at any time, or use tactics to deal devastating blows to your enemies.
[*] Random drops of weapons and armor. Hundreds of weapons spanning from World War II until the modern age await your discovery.
[*] Machine guns, flamethrowers, or rocket launchers - which will you mount on your vehicles as your travel deeper into Scaria and confront evermore dangerous mechanized enemies?
[*] Build and upgrade a camp for your Revolutionaries, allowing you to assign tactics, cook food, upgrade your technologies, and craft armor for your fighters.
[*] Learn about Scaria's epic history of war and revolution through a massive main campaign and a multitude of side missions.
[/list]

And their destiny is competely under your decision.

notes.title: Thank you for your support! Home Behind2 is coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/515678d0c5de152a72ac1aef448901622c096636.png[/img]
[h1]Greeting from the Producer[/h1]
Thank you for your support! Home Behind2 is coming soon!

I am ZPP from TPP Studio, the producer of Home Behind2.
First of all, thank you all for your attention and support to the Home Behind series. 
Your love for our game has always been the biggest motivation for our development.

The first generation of Home Behind was released in 2016 and was also the first work of TPP Studio.
 I am honored to receive a lot of support and encouragement from you since then. 
But at that time, the development capability of us were limited. 
In fact, there are still many shortcomings and room for improvement in our works.

Although Home Behind2 is still being developed by the two of us, we have accumulated more experience and abilities, and have considered the suggestions and voices from many players. 
Therefore, this game will be closer to our dream work compared to the first generation.

Now, let me briefly introduce the upcoming Home Behind2.

[h1]The Story of Home Behind2[/h1]
In Home Behind 2, we travel 10 years in the past to Scaria, homeland of the protagonist from our previous story. Ruled by Akadullah, a brutal dictator, citizens of Scaria are beginning to call for liberation and revolution.

This game is no longer a journey of finding daughter alone, but an adventure story of leading a whole team to seek victory. Banan, a female college student studying abroad, has decided to return to her homeland to participate in the revolution. With help from Prince, an eclectic agent from the Norto Republic, and Haroun, the disgraced son of a tribal leader, will you be able to face the dangers of western Scaria?

[h1]About Demo and complete version[/h1]
In order to let players experience part of the essence of the game earlier, we have released a Demo of Home Behind2 a month ago. 
We are more than happy to hear from players about their  enthusiasm and love for the demo. And we have also receive many eager voices for the complete version.

Here I can tell you that the current progress of the game development is in a state where the main chapters are complete and fully playable. 
[i][u]Many contents that are not opened and displayed in the demo version, as well as the complete plot of hundreds of thousands of words...These will all be reflected in the complete version.
[/u][/i]
[h1]Early Access is coming![/h1]
In order to further develop new content and improve the game, as well as let everyone play the complete content of Home Behind2 as soon as possible, we decided to release it by Early Access model [i][u]on Steam[/u][/i] in the near future.

We also believe that with the early access model, you can interact more actively with other players, collect opinions and suggestions from everyone, respond to everyone's expectations, and make the game better.

[h1]Winter Sale and Release Date[/h1]
During this winter sale, in order to thank you for your support, the previous work will have a [i][u]historically low discount [/u][/i](70% off). In addition, we will officially announce the [i][u]release time[/u][/i] and other information of Home Behind2 that everyone cares about most during the winter sale period (which means a few days later).

[h1]Best Wishes for all of you[/h1]
By following the official Facebook & Twitter account of Coconut Island Games, you could receive the latest information about us.

Finally, wish all of you Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! Thank you very much for your support of Home Behind series. 

Best Regards,

ZPP
